name: hdie_pc_ctrl_cfg

job.purpose: H3 (H-PCCTRL 2026-10-16): measured H2 TT critical path ref_c -> REF lead compare (fanned out to all 32 write-ACT candidates) -> wq_act_physical -> pwin -> wab_oh (-37.9 ps): the compare is now the register ref_lead_q loaded from the same next value ref_c loads (exact, checked equal on every edge of the 54,018-edge policy bench); outline re-sized to util 0.52 from the measured std area 6,327 um2 (H2 gate util 43 %, east third empty). Spine clock kept (H1 default CTS spread 97.7 ps). H4: second strap stage pc_id_qq for the K legality compare (H3 limiter pc_id_q E-face pin register -> incoming_pc compare -> legal -> i_rdy -> K skid enable, -65.3 ps); strap is a die constant held through reset, no cycle change.

pin_regs.reason: the RTL registers its boundary itself (OREG: every PHY command output from a flop; KREG: K request in a 2-entry pin skid, k_rdy from a register; KRREG: K response from a 2-entry skid; RREG: PHY return valid+data captured at the pin; pc_id/refresh_reload straps captured in pc_id_q/refresh_reload_q). Flow pin registers would add a cycle inside the elastic K ready/valid handshake (HBM-stack boundary, owner 10-14) and overflow the skids.
